response.sql: WITH pair_counts AS (SELECT tr.transreg, td.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS transaction_count FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader AS td ON tr.trdref = td.tradereg GROUP BY tr.transreg, td.tradekind), pair_shares AS (SELECT tradekind, transaction_count, transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS transaction_share FROM pair_counts) SELECT tradekind, AVG(transaction_count::numeric) AS average_count_per_pair, AVG(transaction_share) AS average_share_per_pair FROM pair_shares GROUP BY tradekind;
